text:
Jordan C (CS): FYI AcmeCart is hitting 502s from the dedicated pool in us-west-2 since ~08:30. Customer escalated, calling it an SLA risk. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-3147
Kenji H: Any recent deploys to that pool? I'm seeing a bunch of `model-worker` OOM traces in the gvisor logs — @Priya any deploys around 08:20-08:30?
Priya S: I kicked a canary at 08:22 (model variant v1.3-beta) but rolled it back at 08:27 when p95 spiked. Rollback completed but we didn't fully backfill caches. I'm +1 to pin AcmeCart to v1.2.3 for now.
Elena M (eng-platform): Can someone own the rollback/routing? I can run network checks and verify LB rules. @Marco L can you look at autoscaler config?
Marco L: I'm on it. Plan: pause autoscaler, route AcmeCart traffic to fallback pool-b, validate. Give me ~10m to pause and route, then 15m of monitoring. @incident-bot start runbook ENG-3147
incident-bot: Runbook ENG-3147 initiated by Marco L. Steps queued: pause-autoscale -> route-traffic -> validate-metrics. Runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/ENG-3147
Kenji H: Short-term config tweak idea: set `REDWOOD_KV_CACHE_TTL=300` for AcmeCart namespace to reduce cold KV misses while routing. I'll draft a quick PR.
Priya S: PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/882 — needs review. If merged, I'll apply to pool-b once routing is live.
Jordan C (CS): Customer asks for an ETA. Can we commit to a timeline? Marco?
Marco L: ETA: 35-45m to complete pause+route+validation. If infra PR merges fast, could be 25-30m. I'll update the ticket and ping here when route is active.
Elena M (eng-platform): I'll coordinate with Product to flag this as potential SLA exposure and consider temporary credit if not stable in 60m. Tagging @Kenji for postmortem/CR.
Kenji H: Ack. I'll own the postmortem and investigate root cause of the OOMs. Quick log snippet I grabbed: ```ERROR model-worker: Failed to allocate 8GB for KV cache; process killed by OOM```.
Priya S: After route+fix, propose a 10% canary for 20m then ramp to 100% if stable.
Jordan C (CS): Thanks team — I'll tell the customer ETA ~45m and that we'll update in 10m. :thumbsup:
